title: Pricing Methodology — The Renewal Acceptance Rate on Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
**Definition.** For a Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement renewed within its term, the renewal acceptance rate is the renewal rate stated in the final options notice on the agreement, carried at four decimal places. It is stated in US dollars per therm and rounded half up to four decimal places.

### Inputs and their records

| Quantity | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Final options notice | the most recent final options notice on the agreement's notice history |
| Renewal rate | the renewal rate per therm stated on that notice, in US dollars to four decimal places |

### Worked figure (hypothetical notice)

The final options notice offers a renewal rate of 0.8240 per therm. The renewal acceptance rate is 0.8240 per therm.

### Points of reading

- The figure read is the renewal rate per therm on the final options notice, to four decimal places.
- The month-to-month rate the same notice states is the rollover rate, a different figure.
